messages:
Chen: Kicking off follow-up from the rotation+authz PM. New observation: some rotated tokens were accepted for ~30s due to a stale-prefix cache and audit emitter batching dropped ~0.1% of events under load. Let's capture compact owners and quick mitigations.
Maya: Noticing this pattern across two clusters during deploy spikes. Customers saw transient 403->200 flips. We should sample audit events during rotations.
Lars: Can someone paste the minimal log showing the timeline? I want to build a deterministic test.
Chen: paste:
```
2026-08-14T02:11:09Z svc=auth token=ghj456 cache_hit=true token_issued=2026-08-14T02:10:30Z validation=short_circuit
2026-08-14T02:11:09Z emitter status=dropped reason=emitter_buffer_full
```
Priya: Two-pronged: (1) faster validation stamp check on fast-path, (2) sampling probe during rotations to verify audit end-to-end.
Mariela: Agree. Proposed concise action list — reply with :white_check_mark: to accept and add ETA.

Action 1 — Fast-path stamp and reject-window
- Owner: Lars
- What: add token_issue_ts check and reject fast-path if token_age > 20s; unit+integration tests in presubmit.
- Due: 2026-08-18
Lars: :white_check_mark: I'll PR today and request eng-runtime review.

Action 2 — Rotation sampling job (metascan)
- Owner: Maya
- What: run a rotation-sampling job that issues test tokens during live rotations across clusters and asserts audit emission within 90s; results write to metrics for SRE/CS
- Due: 2026-08-21
Maya: :white_check_mark: I'll ship an initial canary that runs on staging and then flip on production for low-volume rotations.

Action 3 — Durable emitter buffer PoC
- Owner: Priya
- What: quick PoC using a local append-only buffer + async forwarder; measure tail latency and throughput; propose Kafka vs S3+Lambda.
- Due: 2026-08-25
Priya: :white_check_mark: PoC by 8/23.

Action 4 — Compliance & billing impact check
- Owner: Chen
- What: check if missing audit events intersect with paid orgs and if any billing attribution anomalies occurred; report to Compliance by 8/22
- Due: 2026-08-22
Chen: I'll coordinate with finance and compliance.

Action 5 — Runbook & staggered rotation pattern
- Owner: Mariela
- What: update rotation runbook to include staggered rollout, sampling probes, and automatic pause on missing_audit_count > 0 for paid orgs
- Due: 2026-08-20
Mariela: Will add commands and sample metrics to the runbook.

ops-bot: Created ticket SEC-5333 "fastpath-stamp-check" assigned to Lars
ops-bot: Created ticket SEC-5334 "rotation-sampling-metascan" assigned to Maya
ops-bot: Created ticket SEC-5335 "durable-emitter-poc" assigned to Priya

Maya: Temporary ops: reduced cache shortcut window to 10s on canary clusters; emitter workers +1 on prod for immediate relief.

Lars: Test idea for fast-path: simulate rotation where issue_ts = now - 25s, expect fast-path false. Add to presubmit.

Priya: PoC notes: local WAL gives best durability with low infra lift; will measure commit latency and memory usage.

Mariela: Recurrence analysis note: this seems like a deploy-spike pattern. Action 5 should add staggered rotation as a guardrail. We'll run a 60-day pattern query as part of that action.

Chen: If anyone sees blocked PR reviews, ping me and I'll escalate. We'll update this thread when items move to in-progress or done. Thanks all. :pray:
